title: Almost Friday’s Tyler Falbo to Direct R-Rated Comedy ‘Boys for Life’; Paramount Sets Theatrical Release Date (EXCLUSIVE)
content:
ByEthan Shanfeld

Tyler Falbo, a writer, director and producer known for his shaping the viral comedy videos of sketch group Almost Friday, is helming an R-rated comedy movie for Paramount.

Titled “Boys for Life,” the film will be released theatrically on April 9, 2027, under Paramount’s newly announced Primal label. While few plot details are available,Varietyhears it is an ensemble comedy about a group of friends reuniting — with a twist.

“Boys for Life” is currently in production. Paramount acquired the project in a competitive situation that also involved A24 and Warner Bros.,Varietyhears. Falbo serves as director and producer, and he co-wrote the script with Max Barrett. Galen Core also serves as producer.

As its de facto showrunner, Falbo is credited with driving the dark, genre-bending humor of “Almost Friday TV,” the sketch comedy arm of theLos Angeles-based digital media companythat launched Will Angus, Eilise Patton and other rising talent into the comedy scene. Falbo is also attached to direct “Last Night Was a Movie,” his TV project starring Almost Friday cast members that’s in development at FX.

Co-writer Barrett is the creator of Friday Beers and co-founder of Almost Friday Media, who, in 2020, formed the company’s original sketch comedy crew of Liam Cullagh, Angus, Chet Collins and Billy Langdon.

The project hails from Paramount Primal, which will focus on “smartly budgeted” films from “next-generation storytellers” across comedy, horror, action and grounded science-fiction. The label recently acquired the U.S. rights to adapt the original screenplay for “A Nightmare on Elm Street”from the Wes Craven estate.

Falbo is represented by Range Media Partners, UTA and Ziffren Brittenham. Barrett is represented by Mosaic, Fox Rothschild and WME.
title_zh: 幾乎是星期五(Tyler Falbo)的泰勒·法爾博(Tyler Falbo)將執導R級喜劇《為了生活而戰(Boys for Life)》；派拉蒙(Paramount)已確定上映日期。
content_zh:
由伊桑·香菲爾德(Ethan Shanfeld)報導

泰勒·法爾博(Tyler Falbo)，一位以塑造網路喜劇小組Almost Friday的病毒式喜劇影片而聞名的編劇、導演和製片人，正在為派拉蒙(Paramount)執導一部R級喜劇電影。

這部電影名為《生命之男孩》(Boys for Life)，將於2027年4月9日正式上映，屬於派拉蒙新宣布的Primal標籤。雖然目前可得的劇情細節不多，但《綜藝》(Variety)聽說這是一部關於一群朋友重聚的群像喜劇——並且有一個意想不到的轉折。

《生命之男孩》目前正在製作中。據《綜藝》報導，派拉蒙在與A24和華納兄弟(Warner Bros.)的競爭中獲得了這個項目。法爾博擔任導演和製片人，並與麥克斯·巴雷特(Max Barrett)共同編寫劇本。蓋倫·科爾(Galen Core)也擔任製片人。

作為事實上的節目主持人，法爾博被認為推動了《Almost Friday TV》的黑暗、跨類型幽默，這是洛杉磯一家數位媒體公司的小品喜劇部門，該公司培養了威爾·安格斯(Will Angus)、艾莉絲·帕頓(Eilise Patton)和其他新興人才進入喜劇界。法爾博還將執導他的電視項目《昨晚是部電影》(Last Night Was a Movie)，該項目由Almost Friday的演員陣容主演，目前正在FX開發中。

共同編劇巴雷特(Barrett)是《星期五啤酒》(Friday Beers)的創作者，也是Almost Friday Media的共同創辦人，他在2020年組建了公司的原始小品喜劇團隊，包括利亞姆·卡拉赫(Liam Cullagh)、安格斯、切特·柯林斯(Chet Collins)和比利·蘭登(Billy Langdon)。

該項目來自派拉蒙Primal，該標籤將專注於來自“下一代故事講述者”的“精明預算”電影，涵蓋喜劇、恐怖、動作和基於現實的科幻類型。該標籤最近獲得了改編韋斯·克雷文(Wes Craven)遺產的原創劇本《厄夜叢林》(A Nightmare on Elm Street)的美國版權。

法爾博由Range Media Partners、UTA和Ziffren Brittenham代表。巴雷特則由Mosaic、Fox Rothschild和WME代表。
